Definition: from G3664 and the alternate of G3958; similarly affected:--of (subject to) like passions.
BiblicalUsage: homoiopathḗs means of (subject to) like passions. It turns up twice, in Acts and James.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: homoiopathḗs means of (subject to) like passions, and I do not stretch it further.
RelatedEvents: Paul Stoned at Lystra; Elijah on Mount Carmel
